description: Optimization objectives for the block planner

maximize.name: Asset Availability
maximize.description: Maximize the percentage of time assets are available for operations

maximize.name: Critical Task Completion
maximize.description: Maximize the proportion of high-priority tasks that get scheduled

maximize.name: Block Utilization
maximize.description: Maximize the fraction of each block that is actively used for maintenance

maximize.name: Multi-Department Coordination
maximize.description: Maximize the number of blocks where multiple departments coordinate

minimize.name: Asset Downtime
minimize.description: Minimize the total time assets are unavailable

minimize.name: Train Disruption
minimize.description: Minimize the impact on scheduled train operations

minimize.name: Number of Blocks
minimize.description: Minimize the total number of separate maintenance blocks

minimize.name: Unused Capacity
minimize.description: Minimize wasted time in each maintenance block

minimize.name: Maintenance Backlog
minimize.description: Minimize the number of unscheduled maintenance tasks

minimize.name: Conflicting Activities
minimize.description: Minimize the number of activities that conflict with each other
